threat_event: Ransomware encrypts store POS servers, the integration platform, the POS head-office application, and DC systems, halting checkout beyond offline mode and stopping replenishment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: POS vendor shared accounts with standing remote access; privileged access management only in the cloud; store server images backed up locally only; cloud workload restores never tested
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03; SYS-04; SYS-07; SYS-08; BP-01; BP-02; BP-06
existing_controls: MFA for workforce; EDR on PCs and store servers with 24x7 MSSP; immutable cloud backups in a separate account; store offline mode tested yearly
treatment_plan: Broker POS vendor access with named accounts; off-site immutable backups of store server images; quarterly cloud restore tests; extend privileged access management; ransomware tabletop with the executive team

threat_event: Malicious script injected into the website or in-app checkout page captures card data typed into the hosted payment fields (e-commerce skimming)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 23 checkout scripts, 8 not inventoried and none integrity-checked; tag manager on checkout pages; tamper detection does not cover the in-app web checkout; agency accounts without MFA
existing_controls: Hosted payment fields (no card data in the platform); change and tamper detection on the website checkout; vendor web application firewall
treatment_plan: Script inventory with justification and integrity values; remove the tag manager from checkout pages; extend tamper detection to the in-app checkout; agency accounts to single sign-on with MFA
exposure_estimate_usd: $400K-$1.5M (about 390 online orders a day; forensics, card reissue costs passed through the acquirer, notices)

threat_event: Memory-scraping malware on registers or store servers captures card data before or during processing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: In-store encryption is not a listed P2PE solution; register anti-malware not monitored by the company; CDE logs not collected
existing_controls: PIN pad encryption at the point of reading; POS VLAN segmentation; EDR on store servers
treatment_plan: Move to a validated P2PE solution at the 2027 terminal refresh; forward register and store server logs to the SIEM; MSSP monitoring of register anti-malware
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$5M (store card compromise across about 1.95 million transactions a year)

threat_event: Failed or qualified PCI DSS validation because the scope document is stale and the POS head-office application in the cloud was never assessed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2025 scope document predates the December 2025 cloud move; no annual scope confirmation
existing_controls: QSA-supported SAQ D each year; quarterly ASV scans
treatment_plan: Update the scope document and data flows before QSA fieldwork; annual scope confirmation step in the PCI calendar

threat_event: Exfiltration of loyalty and CDP data (148,000 members) for extortion or resale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No egress alerting on the loyalty subnet; shared analyst account runs exports; weekly member-level exports emailed
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 loyalty and CDP database; BP-09
existing_controls: Encryption at rest; MFA; database roles limited to the API identity and 4 analysts
treatment_plan: Egress alerting on the loyalty subnet; named service identity for exports; replace emailed exports with a governed transfer
exposure_estimate_usd: $700K-$2.5M (notice, credit monitoring for any credential exposure, FTC inquiry)

threat_event: POS vendor's shared support accounts are stolen or misused to reach store servers and the head-office application
threat_source: Supply chain attacker using a compromised vendor
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 shared vendor accounts with standing remote access; 2 vendor accounts with domain administrator rights; passwords never changed
existing_controls: Vendor contract; store firewalls
treatment_plan: Named vendor accounts through the access broker with MFA, per-session approval, and recording; remove vendor domain administrator rights
exposure_estimate_usd: $1M-$5M (same as R-001 or R-003 if used as the entry point)

threat_event: Attacker who controls one register reuses the identical local administrator password to move to registers at every store
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same register local administrator password at all 5 stores
existing_controls: POS VLAN segmentation per store
treatment_plan: Unique, rotated local administrator passwords per register through the POS vendor's management tool

threat_event: Refrigeration controllers or the contractor's remote tool are compromised or fail, silencing temperature alarms at Stores 4 and 5
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: IoT devices share the corporate VLAN at Stores 4 and 5; always-on contractor remote tool; no alarm-path monitoring
existing_controls: IoT VLANs at Stores 1 to 3 and the DC; manual temperature checks written into procedures
treatment_plan: IoT VLAN with deny-by-default rules at Stores 4 and 5; contractor access through the broker; heartbeat alert when alarms stop reporting; drill manual checks
exposure_estimate_usd: $80K-$300K per store event (product loss, food safety claims)

threat_event: Takeover of a privileged directory, identity provider, or e-commerce administrator account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privileged access management only in the cloud; administrators use everyday accounts with elevated roles; no phishing-resistant MFA
existing_controls: MFA for all workforce; conditional access
treatment_plan: Separate privileged accounts; extend privileged access management; FIDO2 security keys for administrators

threat_event: Marketing agency account or tag vendor compromise is used to add or alter checkout scripts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Agency has full e-commerce admin rights with password-only sign-in; publishes tags without change control; no security terms in the agency contract
existing_controls: Tamper detection on the website checkout
treatment_plan: Agency to single sign-on with MFA and a content-only role; change tickets for all tag changes; security clause in the agency contract

threat_event: Compromise or outage at a payment TPSP (processor, e-commerce platform vendor) exposes company card or customer data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: TPSP list incomplete; 3 AOCs expired; responsibility matrix for 6 of 14 TPSPs
existing_controls: Processor and e-commerce vendor AOCs current; contracts with notice terms for those two
treatment_plan: Complete the TPSP list and responsibility matrix; annual AOC tracking; renew expired AOCs

threat_event: A POS environment compromise goes undetected for weeks because CDE logs are neither collected nor reviewed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Registers, store servers, and POS head-office application not sending logs; store server logs kept about 30 days
existing_controls: EDR on store servers with MSSP monitoring
treatment_plan: Onboard CDE log sources to the SIEM; daily automated review with MSSP use cases; 12-month retention
exposure_estimate_usd: Increases R-003 losses by extending the exposure window

threat_event: Paper catering forms with full card numbers and security codes are stolen or misused by staff or visitors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Forms kept in binders at deli counters; security codes written down; discarded in regular trash at 2 stores
existing_controls: Deli counters staffed during open hours
treatment_plan: Stop writing card data on forms; take payment on the virtual terminal at once or at pickup on a PIN pad; cross-cut shred existing forms

threat_event: Loyalty and CDP database cannot be restored within its RTO after corruption or attack
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Restore never tested; no documented rebuild procedure
existing_controls: Daily immutable backups in a separate account
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests with timing against the 8-hour RTO

threat_event: Integration platform and POS head-office application cannot be rebuilt in time, stopping price files, order flows, and store polling
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rebuild procedures not documented; never restore-tested; POS vendor dependency
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-04 integration platform and POS head office; BP-01; BP-03; BP-05
existing_controls: Daily immutable backups; vendor rebuild guide for store servers
treatment_plan: Documented rebuild runbooks; restore test of the integration platform 2026-10-27 and the POS head office with the vendor by 2027-01-31

threat_event: ERP vendor outage longer than the pricing MTD stops price files and purchasing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor RTO 24 hours versus BIA RTO 12 hours for pricing
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 Type 2; last good price file can run a day
treatment_plan: Recovery term at the 2027 renewal; daily price file export kept in the backup account

threat_event: Payment processor outage stops card and EBT authorization beyond offline-mode limits
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single processor; EBT has no offline mode
existing_controls: Processor redundancy (per its AOC and SOC 2); offline mode for cards up to 24 hours
treatment_plan: Accepted: processor outages beyond a few hours are rare and a second processor costs more than the exposure. Revisit at the 2027 terminal refresh

threat_event: DC network or WMS outage stops store replenishment for more than a day, spoiling fresh product
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single DC; RF handhelds and cold-room controls on the DC network; WMS SaaS has no tested failover
existing_controls: Dual ISP at the DC campus; paper pick list procedure
treatment_plan: DC contingency plan with daily WMS extract; direct-store-delivery agreements with 10 key suppliers; annual DC downtime drill

threat_event: Skimming overlay or swapped PIN pad at a store captures card and EBT data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Weekly inspections recorded only at Stores 1 to 3; 2 PIN pads missing from the device list; inspection training not given at Stores 4 and 5
existing_controls: PCI-approved PIN pads; CCTV over lanes
treatment_plan: Reconcile the device list with the processor; daily self-checkout and weekly lane inspections at all stores with logs; training
exposure_estimate_usd: $50K-$300K (fraud, EBT benefit theft harming SNAP households)

threat_event: Business email compromise changes a supplier's bank details and diverts a payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Bank detail changes confirmed by email reply; finance staff targeted by phishing
existing_controls: Second approver in the ERP for bank detail changes; MFA
treatment_plan: Call-back verification to a known number for every bank change; finance-specific phishing training

threat_event: Phishing of support-center staff leads to account takeover and data access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 6.9% phishing click rate; push MFA can be fatigued
existing_controls: Email filtering with domain authentication enforced; number matching MFA
treatment_plan: Monthly phishing simulations for support-center staff; report button metrics; phishing-resistant MFA for high-risk roles

threat_event: Credential stuffing against customer online accounts steals stored addresses, order history, and saved-card tokens for fraudulent orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Customer MFA optional; no breached-password check
existing_controls: Platform bot protection and rate limiting; card tokens cannot be extracted
treatment_plan: Breached-password check at sign-in; step-up verification for new delivery addresses; promote customer MFA
exposure_estimate_usd: $30K-$200K (refunds, notices for accounts with exposed credentials)

threat_event: FTC deception claim because the privacy notice says member data is not shared, while member-level exports go to the agency and hashed emails go to a supplier
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Privacy notice not updated for agency exports and the supplier data pilot
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Pause the supplier pilot; rewrite the privacy notice; data use agreements with the agency and supplier; data sharing review gate
exposure_estimate_usd: $250K-$2M (FTC order with long-term program obligations; legal costs)

threat_event: Weekly member-level export emailed to the marketing agency is leaked or misused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unencrypted spreadsheets by email; no retention limit; no contract terms
existing_controls: Agency limited to 2 named staff (by practice)
treatment_plan: Replace email with a governed transfer of only the fields needed; contract with security, use, and deletion terms

threat_event: Pricing and offers engine gives lower offer value or higher online prices in lower-income ZIP codes, creating FTC unfairness exposure and customer harm
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No fairness testing at launch; delivery-zone factor available in the engine
existing_controls: Price bounds plus or minus 10% of shelf price
treatment_plan: Monthly fairness tests by ZIP income group; minimum weekly offer floor; delivery-zone factor stays off (P10)

threat_event: Pricing engine raises online prices during a declared state of emergency (hurricane), creating price gouging exposure
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No emergency price freeze configured
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Emergency price freeze setting tested before each hurricane season; added to the hurricane plan (P10)

threat_event: Self-checkout computer vision wrongly flags customers for missed scans, leading to confrontations and discrimination complaints
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No accuracy or fairness monitoring; staff scripts not standardized
existing_controls: Attendant review before any action
treatment_plan: Monthly false-alert sampling by store; attendant script; no customer data retained beyond 30 days (P10)

threat_event: Customer service chatbot gives wrong allergen, recall, or refund information, or collects card numbers in chat
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No testing of answers; free-text field accepts any input
existing_controls: Human handoff button
treatment_plan: Scripted test set before release; block card-number patterns; route allergen and recall questions to staff (P10)

threat_event: Hiring screening module screens out applicants in a way that has disparate impact on a protected group
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Module enabled by HR without adverse impact testing; auto-reject on knockout scores
existing_controls: Recruiters review applicants above the cut score
treatment_plan: Turn off auto-reject; adverse impact testing each quarter; recruiter review of all applicants (P10)

threat_event: Facial recognition for loss prevention is adopted outside governance, repeating the FTC Rite Aid pattern
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor proposal was circulated to store managers
existing_controls: P10 decision declining the proposal; AI approval gate in POL-01
treatment_plan: Keep the decision on the AI approved-tools list; purchasing gate blocks biometric analytics

threat_event: Redemption data errors cause supplier billing disputes and loss of SOC 2 Processing Integrity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No reconciliation between register redemptions and supplier invoices
existing_controls: Monthly manual spot checks
treatment_plan: Automated daily reconciliation with exception reports (P09 PI1)

threat_event: A flaw in the supplier reporting portal lets one supplier see another's campaign and sales data
threat_source: External attacker or curious supplier user
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Company-built portal; no code review or input validation testing since 2025
existing_controls: Row-level filters tested at launch
treatment_plan: Application penetration test; code review in the change process; annual testing

threat_event: Known vulnerability in registers is exploited because vendor patches arrive quarterly and late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 critical updates applied about 90 days late; registers scanned only by the vendor
existing_controls: POS VLAN segmentation; vendor patch cycle
treatment_plan: 30-day critical patch term in the POS contract; company review of internal CDE scans each quarter

threat_event: Malware on a general-purpose service-desk PC captures card numbers keyed into the virtual terminal
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Service-desk PCs used for email and browsing; no screen lock; a shared virtual terminal account at 2 stores
existing_controls: EDR on service-desk PCs
treatment_plan: Dedicated, locked-down virtual terminal PCs with no email; named accounts; or move catering payments to PIN pads

threat_event: Former store employees keep active POS accounts and use them for refund fraud or data access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: POS accounts removed by paper form; 6 of 25 sampled terminations still active (P07); 268 terminations a year
existing_controls: Identity provider access disabled automatically
treatment_plan: Tie POS accounts to the HR feed; weekly terminated-user report until automated; quarterly reviews

threat_event: Staff misuse gift card activation or refunds to steal value
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 cash office leads can void and approve refunds
existing_controls: Exception reports reviewed by the Controller weekly
treatment_plan: Separate void and refund approval roles

threat_event: Hurricane causes multi-day power and network loss at stores and the DC
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generators at the DC and 3 stores only; no generator at Stores 4 and 5
existing_controls: Hurricane plan; generators at the DC and Stores 1 to 3; cellular failover
treatment_plan: Generator connections at Stores 4 and 5; cloud-hosted price and order data available to stores on battery-backed devices

threat_event: Mobile app API abuse exposes customer curbside location or order data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: API authorization not tested since 2025 penetration test; app location data kept 90 days
existing_controls: Annual penetration test of APIs; TLS
treatment_plan: API authorization tests in the 2026 penetration test; cut location retention to 24 hours

threat_event: Customers send card numbers by email or chat to customer service, where they are stored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No auto-redaction; 4 messages with full card numbers found in the shared mailbox in P03 fieldwork
existing_controls: Staff told not to accept card numbers by email
treatment_plan: Auto-redaction rule; delete found messages; chatbot pattern block

threat_event: Store server and register misconfiguration persists because no configuration standard exists
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 68% benchmark compliance on sampled store servers; register settings are vendor defaults
existing_controls: Vendor build images
treatment_plan: STD-01 configuration standard with store server and register baselines; monthly drift report

threat_event: Cloud misconfiguration exposes the data warehouse or file services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails in place; posture findings reviewed weekly
existing_controls: Organization guardrails; posture service; company-managed keys
treatment_plan: Keep guardrails; quarterly posture review with the MSSP

threat_event: Acquirer notice is missed or late because staff do not know the 24-hour term, weakening the company's position in a card brand case
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2024 incident plan lacked acquirer and card brand steps; Store Managers and the Controller not trained
existing_controls: Merchant agreement on file with the Chief Financial Officer
treatment_plan: P08 runbooks with the acquirer step; wallet cards; exercise with the acquirer contact

threat_event: Denial-of-service attack takes the website and app offline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Platform-level protection only
existing_controls: Vendor denial-of-service protection and web application firewall
treatment_plan: Accepted: protection is inherited from the platform vendor (SOC 2, AOC) and online is 12% of sales with a pay-at-pickup workaround

threat_event: Rogue wireless access point is plugged into a store network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No wireless scanning for rogue access points at stores (PCI DSS 11.2 applies because the CDE is in stores)
existing_controls: Port security on POS switches; controller detects unknown access points on corporate Wi-Fi
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low: the wireless controller's rogue detection meets the quarterly check, and POS switch ports are locked. Review after the P2PE migration

threat_event: Loss of the one infrastructure engineer who knows the POS head-office and store server setup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Knowledge not documented
existing_controls: POS vendor support contract
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low with documentation of rebuild procedures under POAM-008

threat_event: Retired registers, handhelds, or store server drives leave without being wiped
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disposal certificates for PCs but not for POS hardware returned to the vendor
existing_controls: Encryption on store servers; vendor collects old registers
treatment_plan: Certificates of destruction for all POS hardware returned to the vendor

threat_event: Price file is altered in the integration platform, causing wrong prices at registers and online
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Integrity checks on record counts only; no approval for out-of-cycle files
existing_controls: Change board; hash totals on scheduled files
treatment_plan: Signed price files and approval for out-of-cycle publishes

threat_event: Store acquisition by the PE sponsor connects an insecure network to the company
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No security due diligence step in the acquisition playbook
existing_controls: None
treatment_plan: Security due diligence checklist and quarantine network for acquired stores

threat_event: SNAP EBT benefits are skimmed at company PIN pads, harming households and risking FNS scrutiny
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Same as R-019; EBT cards rely on magnetic stripe and PIN
existing_controls: Same as R-019
treatment_plan: Covered by the R-019 inspection program; report suspected EBT skimming to the state EBT agency and law enforcement

threat_event: Vendor-installed cellular modem at Store 4 exposes the store POS server's remote management port to the internet (found in P07)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Modem installed by the POS vendor in 2024 for failover support; not in any inventory; default password on the modem
existing_controls: None until found
treatment_plan: Modem disconnected 2026-08-13; sweep all stores for vendor-installed devices; contract clause banning unapproved connections
